# pbs_verify_job (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing PBS verify job configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the verify job.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this verify job.
- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file the object is stored in (shared by all objects in that file; informational only).
- `ignore_verified` (Boolean) Skip snapshots verified after outdated_after.
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum depth for namespace traversal.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace filter (regex).
- `outdated_after` (Number) Days after which to re-verify snapshots.
- `schedule` (String) When the verify job runs.
- `store` (String) The datastore name where verification is performed.
